x: At just turned 20 this young Moroccan really looks the business and with his countryman Najibe Hliouat, 21, setting out a little more cautiously than he did at Brockwell Park we suddenly found that we had exciting company for stalwart Jim Estall.
Sporting claret head-gear, Charles was always our top scorer, ahead of Najibe Hliouat (before he called it a day) and comfortably up on Paul Coughlan, who was having a good run himself.
It was Herne Hill who seemed to have the most men forward while Chris Knight of GEC Avionics took an early lead, chased hard by our own Najibe Hliouat.
